items.name: Moving blobs
items.description: Animated liquid-blob distortion effect: warps the layer beneath through a simplex-noise field with refraction, displacement, bulge/pinch, hue-shift, and invert modes, plus dispersion and drop shadow.

items.name: CRT Screen
items.description: Retro CRT monitor effect over the layer beneath — scanlines, screen curvature, phosphor glow, and chromatic distortion.

items.name: Light rays
items.description: Adds volumetric light rays and edge glow emanating from a positionable light source over the layer beneath.

items.name: Bokeh blur
items.description: Brightness-weighted disc gather that blooms highlights into bokeh discs.

items.name: Channel mixer
items.description: Mixes RGB channels by blending each output channel against a configurable tint color, with optional sRGB/Linear color space selection.

items.name: Shape-based particles
items.description: Interactive shape-based particle system effect over the layer beneath — emits and simulates particles with velocity fields that react to the pointer position.

items.name: Chromatic metal
items.description: Chromatic metal shader effect with configurable gradient, noise, blur, and RGB split controls

items.name: Bloom
items.description: Multi-pass bloom effect with brightness extraction, Gaussian blur at half and quarter resolution, tinted glow composite, vignette, and a spotlight mask

items.name: Color adjust
items.description: Photo-style color adjustment effect — exposure, contrast, levels, highlights/shadows, temperature, tint, color filter, vibrance, saturation, brilliance, and definition/clarity controls

items.name: Halftone
items.description: Halftone effect with dot and blended patterns, CMYK/RGB/BW color modes, and configurable dot size, scale, softness, rotation, and center

items.name: Lens distortion
items.description: Barrel/pincushion lens distortion with chromatic aberration — lateral, longitudinal, and anamorphic modes

items.name: Hatching
items.description: Luminance-driven hatching effect with circle, wave, and zigzag patterns, configurable density, softness, transform, and dual-color controls

items.name: Outlines
items.description: JFA-based SDF outline rings with gradient, phase animation, and smoothing

items.name: Pattern refraction
items.description: Refracts a layer through procedural patterns (lenticular, zigzag, waves, circular, curved/flat square) with IOR dispersion, frost, and configurable edge wrap

items.name: Glowing particles
items.description: Scatters glowing bokeh-like light particles across the layer, sampling bright areas of the source image to seed particle positions and color

items.name: Pixel stretch
items.description: Distorts a layer by stretching pixels along a line segment with offset, smoothness, and falloff controls

items.name: Pixelate
items.description: Pixelate effect with rectangle, ellipse, hexagon, and triangle pixel shapes, configurable size, gap, color trim, dissolve, and region controls

items.name: Slice shift
items.description: Slices the layer into vertical bands and shifts alternating slices horizontally, with configurable shift, softness, random jitter, and a point-angle-radius transform control.

items.name: Warp
items.description: Warp effect with sine wave, twist, bulge, pinch, ripple, flag, squeeze, and swirl distortion modes

items.name: Duotone
items.description: Maps layer luminance to a two-color ramp with contrast, midpoint, and mix controls

items.name: Dither
items.description: Compute-shader dithering with Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, Bayer, Blue Noise, Riemersma and more

items.name: Gradient map
items.description: Maps pixel luminance to a configurable multi-stop gradient ramp, with scatter dithering, repeat/mirror tiling, frequency, offset, and sRGB/Linear/OKLab mix space controls.

items.name: Colored edges
items.description: Detects edges using Sobel operators and renders a customizable colored gradient outline around layer content

items.name: Gooey merge
items.description: Gooey blob-merge effect using multi-pass Gaussian blur and alpha-threshold thresholding to merge nearby shapes into organic blobs

items.name: Filter presets
items.description: Photo-style filter presets — Grayscale, Sepia, Vintage, Cool, Warm, Fade, High Contrast, Vivid, and Noir — with adjustable intensity

items.name: Glowing wave
items.description: Animated glowing sine wave fill with configurable color, amplitude, glow intensity, scale, phase, and transform controls

items.name: Moving gradient
items.description: Animated 3D mesh gradient fill that procedurally renders a flowing, shaded multi-color mesh gradient.

items.name: Mesh gradient
items.description: Bicubic mesh gradient fill with 16 color-point handles, Catmull-Rom interpolation, and 4x MSAA anti-aliasing

items.name: Concentric patterns
items.description: Concentric ring patterns in triangle, circle, or square shapes with configurable ring count, falloff, color, offset, and transform controls

items.name: Pattern grid
items.description: Procedural pattern grid fill with configurable shapes, grid layouts, size, zoom, colors, stroke, softness, clip-to-cell, offset, and transform controls

items.name: Clouds
items.description: Procedural cloud fill with sky gradient, coverage, density, brightness, warp, stretch, and transform controls

items.name: Fractal noise
items.description: Generates static layered procedural noise as a custom fill

items.name: Nebula
items.description: Animated nebula fill with layered star fields and procedural nebula clouds

items.name: Moire
items.description: Moire interference pattern fill with warped sine-wave lines, RGB split, zoom, and warp origin controls

items.name: Water caustic
items.description: Water caustic procedural fill — iterative interference pattern generating shimmering caustic light patterns in configurable water and highlight colors
